retrievalProfile.description: A gritty urban portrait layout featuring a subject framed by vertical wooden textures with distressed, stencil-like red display typography overlaid across the center.
triggerTerms: urban sepia photography with red accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a male figure wearing a cap and jewelry, positioned behind vertical weathered wooden beams. The color palette is dominated by warm sepia and brown tones, contrasted by a bold, distressed red horizontal text block that spans the width of the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject partially obscured by foreground vertical textures
Horizontal text block cutting across the subject's torso
Warm sepia photography contrasted with vibrant distressed red graphics
Rough wooden textures echoing the gritty typographic treatment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered vertically, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, scaled to a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, distressed red display text in the lower-middle third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down to the bold red text, and then follow the vertical lines of the wooden planks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight composition with minimal negative space, filled by wooden textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and brown (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red (primary typography and graphic elements)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White (secondary text and highlights on clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the desaturated, warm-toned photo and the highly saturated red graphic overlay.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and primary red

letterConstructionRules: Distressed, eroded edges suggesting stencil or spray-paint application
Horizontal stretching on the primary display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature 'chipped' edges and internal texture gaps
Horizontal bars are slightly thickened to enhance the stencil feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy distressed display face paired with a clean, smaller sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory style black and white box

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and blocky nature of the display text.
Captures the urban, industrial feel of the lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium close-up portrait of a man with a beard and cap, looking at the camera, framed by vertical weathered wooden planks. The lighting is warm and the overall image has a sepia-toned, gritty urban aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, distressed red sans-serif title across the lower-middle section. Above it, add a smaller white sans-serif subtitle. Include a black and white rectangular advisory label in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the red text sufficiently distressed?
Does the subject appear framed by vertical wood?
Is the color palette primarily sepia and red?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress on the red text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text is the primary visual anchor.
Ensure the wooden texture looks weathered and realistic.
Verify the sepia tone is consistent across the photograph.
Confirm the distressed edges of the text do not compromise legibility.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Vertical Wood Framing + Distressed Red Display Type + Sepia Grading
